The tattoos feature a repeating pattern of hexagons, each containing a smaller geometric design at the center, resembling a star or a cross. The hexagons are outlined in black ink, creating a striking contrast against the skin's natural tone. The setting appears to be indoors, as suggested by the neutral gray background that provides a clean and unobtrusive backdrop for the tattoo. There is no indication of any specific activity taking place, as the focus is solely on the tattooed arm.
